title: Mega Man: The Power Battle
note: Capcom CPS1 fighting game: health, health_p2, time (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x10 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x10 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move

hd.note: HD themes of the fights (one per game, no stage value known), made by tools/cps_games.py
